answer: Resist sybils with adaptive risk-escalated verification: every identity carries a live risk score built from its behavior — fresh wallets, burst activity and copied phrasing all push it up. A high score means steeper bonds, harder challenges and more frequent audits, while an honest agent with a clean record passes once, light as a sonnet. A sybil farm cannot hide: its correlated signals drag every fake into the umber depths of the expensive tier at once, so a gale of ten thousand fakes pays ten thousand escalating costs, while one honest agent stays cheap.
